Aderall
One day I decided to purchase some aderall out of curiousity and before school that day I bought 4, 30 mg tablets of aderall. That day when I went into school I decided to take 2 of the pills and after 30-40 minutes felt no effects so I took the other 2 (this was dumb and is not recommended) and I thought that it would be like a mass amount of caffine, I was wrong
After about 15 minutes after all the pills were taken I noticed a definite effect but it was not what I had expected for the first 2-3 hours I made absoluteley no movement except for licking the roof of my mouth (I have no idea why) and as I stared at a blue, brick wall, blobs of colors started to appear and formed many intracite designs and I sat staring at the ceiling for 2 hours straight (I was in the same place all day except for lunch) when I had to get up walking felt very weird and I could not feel my feet touching the ground. Then the hyperness started and all I wanted to do was run or any sort of physical activity for the next 6 hours. I knew I was not going to be able to sleep and when I laid in bed I felt a feeling of heavyness much like that of when I wake up after smoking weed the next morning and my legs feel heavy (for me anyway) I did not sleep for a minute and at 6 0 clock the next morning as I laid in bed wide awake I began to see colors until I got out of bed 30 minutes later. Throughout the 'trip' I felt an extreme euphoria rush to my head while doing anything physical (talking, urinating ect.)
The next day was very much like a hangover but more unpleasent with brightness of colors, a headache and nausea.
